A broker profile in the workbench names a credential by its reference; VERA hands the username and password only to an approved mqtt-tool run of the plugin enabled for that workbench, on the program's input, never in its arguments, environment, logs or results. The agent never sees them.

wokwiTokens.description: Wokwi CI tokens for the official wokwi plugin, which runs firmware simulations in Wokwi's cloud. A simulation job names a token by its reference; VERA hands the token only to an approved wokwi-tool run of the plugin enabled for that workbench, on the program's input, never in its arguments, logs or results. The agent never sees it. Each cloud run sends the job's firmware and diagram to Wokwi and counts against your Wokwi plan.

workbenchTools.parse_log: Parse captured ESP-IDF, Zephyr or ISO logs into counts and cited events. Outside input paths require Bypass; VERA application data is refused.
workbenchTools.web_download: Download a public file (PDF, ZIP, CSV, text, images or other formats) to .vera/downloads, subject to session permissions. Preview PDFs in VERA or locate other files in Explorer. Downloads are not automatically indexed.
workbenchTools.run_program: Run enabled plugin programs with risk rules and approvals; Bypass also allows outside folders and files.
workbenchTools.program_output: Read the output of a background program run.
workbenchTools.plugin_validate: Validate a plugin draft and report schema issues and warnings. Outside input paths require Bypass; VERA application data is refused.
workbenchTools.plugin_install: Request review and install a draft as a trial plugin. Outside input paths require Bypass; VERA application data is refused.
workbenchTools.apply_candidate: Write a checked kicad-layout candidate over its source board after you ask to apply it. Needs the official kicad-layout plugin; asks for approval like a write. Outside input paths require Bypass; VERA application data is refused.
workbenchTools.electrical_model: Read the electrical project model, its completeness issues and plugin results with their freshness. Needs an electrical or automation plugin.
workbenchTools.electrical_model_change: Change the electrical project model through validated operations or an import with an explicit ID mapping. Needs an electrical or automation plugin; asks for approval like a write. Outside input paths require Bypass; VERA application data is refused.
workbenchTools.industrial_catalog: Read the workbench's industrial catalogs: find items by order code or distributor SKU, select by firm requirements with cited values and look up coordination for exact products. Needs the industrial-catalog plugin. Outside input paths require Bypass; VERA application data is refused.
workbenchTools.electrical_network: Calculate a radial LV network of the electrical model: load balance per scenario, phase currents, cable sections from a cited cable table, voltage drop and fault currents; stores the result after approval like a write. Needs the electrical-network plugin. Outside input paths require Bypass; VERA application data is refused.
workbenchTools.protection_coordination: Check fuses and circuit breakers from an industrial catalog against a current network result: breaking capacity of the named kind, overload, disconnection time, let-through energy, and selectivity or starter coordination from manufacturer tables only; stores the result after approval like a write. Needs the protection-coordination plugin. Outside input paths require Bypass; VERA application data is refused.
workbenchTools.motor_drives: Compare direct-on-line, reversing, star-delta, softstarter and variable-speed drive per motor against the process function and a current protection result; propose the simplest feasible method, size its contactors, overload relay, softstarter or drive and give a logical connection and interlock scheme; stores the result after approval like a write and never configures a device. Needs the motor-drives plugin. Outside input paths require Bypass; VERA application data is refused.
workbenchTools.power_quality: Evaluate power factor correction at one board from a current network result and a measurement file with declared units and conventions: displacement versus total power factor, the kvar need to a target, a fixed or automatic bank with steps, overcompensation, capacitor, reactor, contactor and protection checks from cited data and resonance against measured harmonics; stores the result after approval like a write and switches no step. Needs the power-quality-pfc plugin. Outside input paths require Bypass; VERA application data is refused.
workbenchTools.lighting_design: Design interior lighting from a lighting project with IES or LDT photometry: a preliminary lumen-method estimate with cited utilisation factors and the direct component on the calculation grid, diagnostics for scale, units, orientation and photometry, and verification of maintained illuminance, uniformity and glare only from a matched photometric engine report such as DIALux evo; stores the result after approval like a write and runs no engine. Needs the lighting-design plugin. Outside input paths require Bypass; VERA application data is refused.
workbenchTools.decode_register: Decode a captured register value using a local JSON definition, with exact field values and cited sources. Reads no device. Outside input paths require Bypass; VERA application data is refused.
workbenchTools.parts_search: Search the enabled supplier catalogs (Mouser, DigiKey, TME, Farnell, Rutronik) by keyword or part number. Needs Web access, the official parts-search plugin and a supplier set up in the plugin's Configuration on the Plugins page.
workbenchTools.help: Read VERA's own help pages and the help of the workbench's enabled plugins, to answer questions about VERA. Read-only.
workbenchTools.run_command: Run shell commands with approval in Ask and Auto-edit, or without asking in Bypass.
workbenchTools.terminal_read: Read recent user terminal output only with consent for that terminal.
